question: Among never-served world edges that ever form a reported loop, does the direct temporal count remain positively associated with final assertion after rank and seed are held fixed?
scope: Twelve fresh seeds, one compositional world family, 120 cycles, cap 40, loop-forming never-served edges only.

reference.status: exploratory Q4 subgroup fit, not confirmatory

design.world: generate_compositional_world(seed=, cycles=120) with the PHASE_ACQUISITION schedule and one replay per seed
design.population: every world edge with zero direct served windows AND ever_loop=True; the loop term is therefore constant and is not estimated
design.rank: minimum 1-based position in the repaired observer's full pre-cap universe across all 120 cycles
design.loop: ever_loop: at least one reported loop_candidate path contains the edge in either orientation in any cycle
design.freshness: The collision scan over docs JSON is empty at freeze time. No seed in this block has been replayed before the freeze.

model.formula: logit P(asserted) = b0 + b_rank*z(log2(min_rank)) + b_count*z(direct_count) + seed fixed effects
model.estimator: Firth penalized likelihood (Jeffreys prior); fixed before the run because the subgroup is small and the event count is limited
model.seed: twelve-level fixed effect, first seed as reference

inference.primary: Firth Wald 95% interval for the count odds ratio per 1 SD. The count coefficient is the single primary criterion.
inference.secondary: Rank OR per 1 SD, reported descriptively with its interval; no rank-based verdict.
inference.multiplicity: one primary coefficient; rank is secondary and unadjusted
inference.no_causal_claim: Observational subgroup model; no coefficient is causal.

gates.M1_population: at least 40 loop-forming never-served edges and 10 asserted events; no duplicate seed-edge rows
gates.M2_rank_coverage: at least 95% of loop-forming edges have a finite rank
gates.M5_convergence: Firth fit converges with finite coefficients and information
gates.M6_complete: every fitted row has a finite rank and a count

not_evidence: A twelve-seed observational subgroup model in one synthetic world family. It does not establish causation, capability, retention, transfer or a general engine property.
